title: Finite Tate lines on the small etale site and their pullback
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $m\geq1$ an integer with $mA=0$, and $T$ a scheme [def-pc-scheme] on which $m$ is invertible. Use the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], constant coefficient module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and their unbounded derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Let $\mu_{m,T}$ be the sheaf $V\mapsto\{z\in\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)^\times:z^m=1\}$, with its $\mathbf Z/m$-module structure given by powers. Set $A_T(1)=\mu_{m,T}\otimes_{\mathbf Z/m}A_T$, using sheaf tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], $A_T(0)=A_T$, $A_T(a)=A_T(1)^{\otimes_A a}$ for $a>0$, and $A_T(-a)=\mathcal Hom_A(A_T(a),A_T)$ for $a>0$, where sheaf Hom is [def-pur-sheaf-hom]. These are locally constant sheaves locally free of rank one over $A_T$, meaning that $T$ admits a jointly surjective family of etale morphisms on each of which the sheaf is isomorphic to the constant coefficient sheaf $A$. For every morphism $v:T'\to T$, the comparison induced by inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] of roots of unity is an isomorphism $v^{-1}\mu_{m,T}\cong\mu_{m,T'}$, hence gives canonical isomorphisms $v^{-1}A_T(a)\cong A_{T'}(a)$ for every integer $a$, compatible with tensor products, evaluation, identities and composition. For $K\in D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ use derived tensor [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback] and put $K(a)=K\otimes_A^L A_T(a)$; these identifications give $v^{-1}(K(a)[b])\cong(v^{-1}K)(a)[b]$ for all $a,b\in\mathbf Z$, with the same tensor and composition compatibility. If $m'\geq1$, $m\mid m'$ and $m'$ is invertible on $T$, the map $z\mapsto z^{m'/m}$ induces the canonical identification of the constructions using $m'$ and $m$.
